summary: Interpretation of Income Tax Act provisions post-Finance Act 2021 amendments; interplay between reassessment time limits under Section 149(1) and Taxation and Other Laws (Relaxation and Amendment of Certain Provisions) Act 2020 (TOLA); validity of notices issued between April 2021-June 2021 under old regime; TOLA extends time limit till 31 June 2021; notices issued June-September 2022 deemed invalid; reassessment notices require proper sanctioning authority; strict interpretation of tax provisions; harmonious construction applied; jurisdictional limits and quasi-judicial functions examined.
final_judgment: Appeals allowed in part; validity of reassessment notices issued between 1 April 2021-30 June 2021 confirmed; notices issued after 30 June 2021 declared invalid; matter remanded for compliance with sanction requirements under Section 151.
